headline: Ontario Superior Court of Justice Certifies Consumer Protection and Competition Act Class Action Against Intuit
summary: On July 24, 2026, Justice Leiper of the Ontario Superior Court of Justice certified a consumer protection class action against Intuit Canada ULC and its U.S. parent, Intuit Inc. (together, "Intuit"). The action was brought on behalf of all consumers who purchased the TurboTax online software since January 1, 2015 to prepare and/or file their Canadian taxes.
